Article Title: Phuket-Delhi AI flight captain's confirmatory test also positive for marijuana: Sources
Article Text:
Several people were injured when Air India flight faces severe turbulence

NEW DELHI: The confirmatory dope test of the pilot-in-command (PIC) operating Air India's Phuket-Delhi flight last Tuesday has also come positive, say sources. His screening test done on arrival was "non negative" and then as per procedure, a confirmatory test was conducted whose report came Tuesday.Sources say the plot has tested positive for marijuana, which is commonly known as weed. The DGCA is now working for more strict dope test requirements to act as an effective deterrent.Meanwhile, aviation secretary Samir Sinha called Air India's outgoing CEO Campbell Wilson where officials of the DGCA and AAIB were present. The officials asked AI to ensure safety of operations from all aspects and asked what steps is the airline taking to the effect.Also read | 'Taking matter seriously,' says aviation minister as turbulence-hit Air India flight pilot fails 2nd dope test The pilots of Air India’s August 4 Phuket-Delhi flight, which had experienced a sudden loss of altitude of about 300 feet during cruise, were subjected to psychoactive substance (dope) screening test on arrival at the destination. The pilot-in-command or captain’s screening test report was “not negative” and has been sent for confirmatory tests, the aviation ministry said Sunday.The ministry has classified the incident, which led to 17 people being hospitalised, as a serious one and the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) will probe it.“Further action, as appropriate, will be taken based on the outcome of the investigation and confirmatory test results,” government said.Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) rules stipulate that “in case the screening test (for psychoactive substances) is non-negative, the employee shall be immediately removed from the safety sensitive duty till a confirmatory report is received. In case of positive confirmatory test for the first time, the concerned employee shall be referred by the organisation” for de-addiction.Multiple passengers and cabin crew members on board the Airbus A320 operating as AI 2379 were injured when it suddenly lost altitude. The plane later landed safely in Delhi. “As standard operating procedures following such an occurrence, both flight crew members underwent the prescribed psychoactive substance screening test. The screening test in respect of the pilot-in-command (PIC) indicated a result requiring confirmatory testing. Samples have accordingly been sent to the designated laboratory for confirmatory analysis, and the final report is awaited,” the ministry statement added.Both the pilots have been taken off flying duty by the DGCA pending investigation.“… firmly committed to highest standards of aviation safety and ensuring that all such occurrences are thoroughly investigated and appropriate action is taken in accordance with the prescribed regulations and procedures,” the statement added.Authorities are probing this case from all angles including what caused the sudden of altitude, weather or something else; the handling of this event; impact on the aircraft like did it suffer hydraulic failure due to impact and whether it should have flown all the way to Delhi after the episode and not diverted to some nearby airport like Varanasi or Lucknow.DGCA rules stipulate that a pilot testing positive for consumption of psychoactive substances for the first time be referred to for de-addiction and rehabilitation. Such crew member can return for active duties with a negative dope test report.But after resuming flying if the same person tests positive for psychoactive substances again, their licence will be suspended for three years. And if after resuming flying the same person again tests positive for the third time, the flying licence is cancelled.
Article Summary: Sources say the plot has tested positive for marijuana, which is commonly known as weed. The confirmatory dope test of the pilot-in-command (pic) operating air india's phuket-delhi flight last tuesday has also come positive, say sources. His screening test done on arrival was "non negative" and then as per procedure, a confirmatory test was conducted whose report came tuesday.

Article Title: 'Taking matter seriously': Aviation minister as turbulence-hit Air India flight pilot fails 2nd dope test
Article Text:
DGCA working on stricter testing requirements

AAIB begins probe

NEW DELHI: Union civil aviation minister Ram Mohan Naidu on Tuesday said the ministry is taking the matter seriously and has sought an update from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) on the existing regulations, after the confirmatory dope test of the pilot-in-command of an Air India Phuket-Delhi flight returned positive.When asked about possible changes to the rules, Naidu said, “That issue we are continuously studying. We have also asked DGCA for updates on that. We are taking it very seriously. If we feel that the present regulation is not up to the mark, we will respond to it very seriously and improve whatever needs to be done.”The development comes after the August 4 Phuket-Delhi Air India flight AI 2379 experienced a sudden loss of altitude of around 300 feet during cruise, leaving several passengers and crew members injured. The Airbus A320 later landed safely in Delhi, while 17 people were subsequently hospitalised.The pilot-in-command's initial psychoactive substance screening test conducted after the aircraft landed in Delhi was reported as “non-negative”, following which a confirmatory test was carried out as per procedure.The DGCA is now working on stricter dope-testing requirements for flight crew, with the aim of creating a stronger deterrent against substance abuse among pilots.Under the existing rules, a crew member whose screening test is non-negative is immediately removed from safety-sensitive duties until the confirmatory report is received. If the first confirmatory test is positive, the employee is referred for de-addiction and rehabilitation.A pilot can return to active flying after rehabilitation and a subsequent negative dope test. However, if the pilot tests positive again after resuming flying, the licence can be suspended for three years. A third positive test can lead to cancellation of the flying licence.The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) has taken up the investigation into the August 4 Air India AI 2379 Phuket-Delhi incident under applicable provisions and ICAO protocols.Statement releasedf by ministry of civil aviation reads, "AAIB is presently engaged in the systematic collection, preservation and examination of all relevanttechnical, operational, medical and human-factor evidence. This includes examination of the aircraft and its systems, recorded flight data, relevant operational and maintenance records, medical information, and interviews with persons concerned.The objective is to determine the circumstances and contributing factors behind the incident and identify safety measures to prevent a recurrence. It also cautioned against drawing conclusions from isolated or incomplete information before the investigation is complete, it reads further.
Article Summary: Dgca working on stricter testing requirements for flight crew. Aircraft accident investigation bureau (aaib) has taken up the investigation into the august 4 air india ai 2379 phuket-delhi incident under applicable provisions and icao protocols.

Article Title: 'Hopeful' Bangladesh races to save India tour, says foreign ministers involved in talks
Article Text:
Mohammad Saifuddin of Bangladesh bats during the Asia Cup match between India and Bangladesh at Dubai International Stadium on September 24, 2025 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. (Photo/Getty Images)

Bangladesh is trying to save India's six-match cricket tour next month, with the foreign ministers of both countries involved in efforts to resolve the issue, news agency AFP reported.The tour consists of three ODIs and three T20Is. It was originally scheduled for August last year but was postponed after relations between Dhaka and New Delhi deteriorated.Bangladesh sports minister Aminul Haque said on Monday that discussions were continuing at the ministerial level."It is being worked on at the ministerial level," Haque said late Monday, as quoted by AFP, adding that talks were ongoing between the foreign ministers of both countries.Relations between Bangladesh and India have been strained since a mass uprising in Bangladesh in 2024 led to the removal of then-prime minister Sheikh Hasina. She fled to India, where she remains in hiding.In February, Bangladesh did not send a team to India for the T20 World Cup, citing security concerns. The International Cricket Council rejected Bangladesh's request to move its matches to Sri Lanka, and Scotland replaced them in the tournament.Haque said Bangladesh was keen to resolve the issue surrounding the postponed series."We want to quickly resolve the deadlock that was created around the Cricket World Cup," Haque said."God willing, we are hopeful that it will be resolved very soon."India last toured Bangladesh for a cricket series in 2022, when they won the two-Test series 2-0. Bangladesh won the three-match ODI series 2-1.Bangladesh last toured India in September-October 2024 for two Tests and two T20Is. India won both series, completing a sweep across the two formats.

Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “She is the person who makes me feel complete.” - How Cristiano Ronaldo and his wife Georgina Rodríguez built a family legacy beyond football
Article Text:
Inspiring story of the day: “She is the person who makes me feel complete.” - How Cristiano Ronaldo and his wife Georgina Rodríguez built a family legacy beyond football

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez meet

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez build their family

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez face tragedy

Why is Cristiano Ronaldo’s marriage to Georgina Rodríguez huge

Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are married, turning a relationship that began in Madrid a decade ago into a chapter for their family. The couple tied the knot in a civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on August 11, 2026, according to People. Their story has never been only about Ronaldo’s football career. It has also included five children, a devastating loss, moves across countries and years of questions about marriage. Now husband and wife, Ronaldo and Rodríguez have reached a milestone they once spoke about as something that would happen when the right moment came.Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez first crossed paths in Madrid in 2016, when Rodríguez was working at a Gucci store. Ronaldo was playing for Real Madrid at the time, and what started as a brief meeting soon became a relationship that changed both their lives.Rodríguez has spoken about that first meeting and how she noticed Ronaldo. The pair later made their relationship public, appearing together at the Best FIFA Football Awards in January 2017. Ronaldo’s eldest son, Cristiano Jr., was also with them at the event.Their early relationship was not built around a wedding or a big public announcement.Instead, they gradually became part of each other’s daily lives. Rodríguez entered a family that already included Cristiano Jr., while Ronaldo became a major part of her life as she moved from working in a shop to becoming one of the most recognisable people in football’s inner circle.Ronaldo has also been open about how important Rodríguez became to him. In a 2019 interview with Piers Morgan, he spoke about the role she played in his life.“Geo is part of me. She’s helped me so much. I’m in love with her and she’s the passion for me. She’s great. She’s my friend. We have conversations. I open the heart for her and she opens the heart for me.”That relationship grew while Ronaldo’s career kept demanding more from him. Real Madrid was followed by Juventus, Manchester United and then Saudi Arabia, but Rodríguez remained a constant presence beside him.Family became an even bigger part of Ronaldo and Rodríguez’s story as their relationship grew. Ronaldo was already a father to Cristiano Jr. before meeting Rodríguez. In 2017, twins Eva and Mateo were born via surrogacy, and later that year Rodríguez gave birth to their daughter, Alana Martina.The couple’s family grew again in 2022, but the year also brought their hardest loss. Rodríguez was expecting twins, Bella Esmeralda and a boy named Ángel. Bella survived, while Ángel died during childbirth.The family had to deal with that loss while also caring for their other children. Ronaldo later explained how difficult it was to answer their questions when they returned home with Bella but without her twin brother.The family has since continued to raise five living children: Cristiano Jr., Eva, Mateo, Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda. Ángel remains part of the family’s story and is remembered by his parents and siblings.For Ronaldo, fatherhood has become a major part of his life away from football. His public image is built around goals, training and records, but his family has often been the part of his life he speaks about with the most emotion.That became especially clear after the loss of Ángel. Ronaldo credited Rodríguez with helping him find the strength to return to football while their family was still dealing with grief.“Georgina came home and the kids start to say where’s the other baby, where’s the other baby? The answers were not easy, but we decided to be honest… Geo gave me that strength to get back to playing, to get back to training every day.”The loss of Ángel changed the family, but it did not break the bond between Ronaldo and Rodríguez. Instead, they had to learn how to grieve while continuing to care for their children.Ronaldo spoke about the experience in 2022, explaining that being honest with the children was part of how the family dealt with what had happened. Rodríguez also continued to share parts of family life publicly, although the couple kept the most painful parts of their loss private.That period also showed why their relationship had become more than a celebrity romance. Ronaldo’s football career has taken him around the world, while Rodríguez has built her own career in modelling, television and fashion. Yet their family life has remained at the centre of their relationship.For years, marriage was another subject that followed them. Fans and media repeatedly asked when Ronaldo and Rodríguez would get married. The answer, however, was never simply about picking a date.Ronaldo had previously said he believed the wedding would happen when they reached the right point in their relationship.“I always told her, ‘When we get that click,’ like everything with our life and she knows what I’m talking about. It could be in one year, or it could be in six months or in one month. I’m 100 percent sure it will happen… She is the person who makes me feel complete.”That moment eventually arrived. Rodríguez announced their engagement on August 11, 2025, exactly one year before their wedding. Reuters also documented the engagement announcement at the time.The wedding is huge because it closes one of the longest-running chapters in Ronaldo and Rodríguez’s relationship. For years, they lived as partners and parents without officially becoming husband and wife. Now, that has changed.Their wedding also comes after almost 10 years together, during which they built a family while Ronaldo continued one of the most demanding careers in football. Their relationship has survived constant public attention, major career moves and a deeply painful family tragedy.The couple’s story is also different from the usual football power-couple narrative because so much of it has happened away from the pitch. Ronaldo’s records and trophies made him one of the biggest names in sport, but his relationship with Rodríguez has shown another side of his life.Their five children are now part of a family shaped by both happy memories and difficult ones. Rodríguez has been beside Ronaldo through career changes, while Ronaldo has supported her as she built her own public career.The marriage does not change what Ronaldo has achieved in football. It simply adds another major moment to a personal story that has developed alongside his career.Cristiano Ronaldo conquered the football world through sheer willpower, but he found his true purpose at home. By standing shoulder-to-shoulder with his wife, Georgina, through triumph and tragedy, he proves that the most valuable title you can ever hold is being a devoted partner and parent.
Article Summary: Cristiano ronaldo and georgina rodríguez have tied the knot in a civil ceremony in cascais, portugal, on august 11, 2026. The couple first met in 2008 while ronaldo was playing for real madrid. Their relationship grew as they became part of each other's daily lives.

Article Title: Did Aaron Rodgers reveal a hidden NFL scandal? Were fake COVID vaccine cards really used by multiple players?
Article Text:

What Aaron Rodgers said about fake COVID-19 vaccine cards

Why Aaron Rodgers’ vaccination controversy still follows him

Aaron Rodgers has once again dragged one of the NFL ’s most divisive COVID-19 controversies back into the spotlight. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback recently revisited the league’s vaccination era, claiming that some players may have relied on fake vaccine cards in 2020. A former NFL scout has now backed Rodgers’ claim with an allegation of his own, saying he personally knew players who told him they had obtained fraudulent documentation.Rodgers made the comments while discussing the COVID-19 era during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show. The quarterback has remained one of the most outspoken NFL figures when it comes to his experience during the pandemic.His latest comments revive memories of the controversy that followed him in 2021, when Rodgers tested positive for COVID-19 after previously telling reporters that he had been “immunized.” NFL reporting later confirmed that Rodgers was not vaccinated and that the league treated him as an unvaccinated player.Rodgers now claims the issue extended beyond his own situation.“A lot of people had probably FAKE vax cards back in the day too," Rodgers said. “I remember seeing some of the vax cards. It was like written in CRAYON."The remark immediately raises questions about how widely fraudulent vaccination documentation may have been used inside professional sports.However, Rodgers did not provide a verified number of players who allegedly used fake cards.A former NFL scout using the name “AngryScoutVet” on X subsequently claimed that he had firsthand knowledge of players who obtained fake vaccination records.“I know this for a fact to be true," he wrote on X. "I know some players really well who told me they got fake vax cards. I have no clue the overall numbers but had a player tell me he thought 50% or more of those who supposedly got the vax actually got a fake card. I wondered if that % was close."The figure mentioned by the scout remains an unverified estimate. There is no evidence in the supplied reporting establishing that half of NFL players used fake vaccination cards.Rodgers' comments carry extra weight because his own vaccination status became one of the NFL's biggest off-field stories during the 2021 season.After testing positive, Rodgers explained that he had pursued alternative treatment rather than receiving a COVID-19 vaccine approved for use in the United States. The NFL and NFL Players Association did not accept that treatment as equivalent to vaccination, and Rodgers was subject to the protocols applied to unvaccinated players.The controversy became even more intense after his use of the word “immunized” was scrutinized. Rodgers later acknowledged that he had misled some people about his vaccination status while maintaining that he had been truthful about his broader position.That history explains why his latest comments have attracted attention years later.Rodgers is now preparing for another NFL season with the Steelers, but his opinions away from football continue to generate headlines. His recent remarks about Dr. Anthony Fauci and the pandemic have already sparked reactions, while Pittsburgh has emphasized that players are entitled to their personal views.The latest fake-vaccine-card allegations add another layer to a controversy that has never completely disappeared from Rodgers' public image. For now, however, the claims about other NFL players remain allegations rather than independently verified facts.
Article Summary: Aaron rodgers claims some nfl players may have relied on fake vaccine cards in 2020. Former nfl scout backs rodgers' claim, saying he personally knew players who told him they had obtained fraudulent documentation. Rodgers made the comments while discussing the covid-19 era during an appearance on the pat mcafee show.

Article Title: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s 2014 photo resurfaces as fans call it ‘proof’ of invisible string theory
Article Text:
Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton (Getty Images)

Why Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s old photo is going viral

What is the invisible string theory behind Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

A decade-old celebrity photo has suddenly become one of the internet’s favorite pieces of relationship evidence. A 2014 image showing Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton at the same event has resurfaced after the pair’s romance became public, sending fans back to a time when neither appeared likely to become the other’s partner. Now, social media users are calling the coincidence a perfect example of the viral “invisible string theory.”The photograph was taken at the 2014 GQ Men of the Year Awards in London. At the time, Hamilton was dating Nicole Scherzinger, while Kardashian was with Ye, formerly known as Kanye West.More than a decade later, the image looks very different.One Reddit post shared the photograph with the caption, “This 2014 picture really hits different in 2026.” Another commenter simply asked, “What do they call it? The invisible string theory?”The idea has also been picked up by entertainment media, with Page Six describing Kardashian and Hamilton as possible “proof” that the theory “really does exist.”The fascination is not difficult to understand. Kardashian and Hamilton had already been part of the same celebrity circle for years before romance rumors emerged. Their paths crossed at major fashion, entertainment and sporting events, long before they publicly acknowledged their relationship.Their romance began attracting serious attention in 2026 after reports linked them to a private getaway. The relationship later became increasingly visible, including their appearance together around the Super Bowl and Kardashian’s support for Hamilton at the Monaco Grand Prix.Hamilton also publicly acknowledged Kardashian’s support after his second-place finish in Monaco, saying, “It's amazing to have her come this weekend and have the support ... It's amazing to have good people around you and good people supporting you and she does that for me every day.”By June, Kardashian had made the relationship more public through social media, confirming what had previously been the subject of intense speculation.The “invisible string theory” is not a scientific theory. It is a romantic idea based on the belief that certain people are connected by an unseen force and may eventually find their way to each other.Its roots stretch back centuries. Chinese folklore, for example, includes the idea of a red thread connecting people who are destined to meet. The modern version became especially popular online after Taylor Swift referenced an invisible connection in her song “Invisible String.”Social media has since turned the concept into a way for people to explain strange coincidences in relationships. Old photographs, childhood encounters and unexpected meetings are often revisited after two people eventually become romantically involved.That is exactly what has happened with Kardashian and Hamilton.The theory can be comforting, particularly for people recovering from heartbreak or searching for a meaningful relationship. But relationship experts also warn against taking the idea too literally. Believing someone is “meant” for you can sometimes encourage people to overlook incompatibility or tolerate unhealthy behavior.For Kardashian and Hamilton, the 2014 photograph cannot prove that fate connected them. It does, however, offer a striking snapshot of two people whose lives were already overlapping long before romance entered the picture.And that may be why the old image feels so different in 2026.
Article Summary: A decade-old celebrity photo has suddenly become one of the internet’s favorite pieces of relationship evidence. A 2014 image showing kim kardashian and lewis hamilton at the same event has resurfaced. Now, social media users are calling the coincidence a perfect example of the viral “invisible string theory.”

Article Title: Inside Erling Haaland’s unlikely friendship with billionaire founder: Luxury trips, WAGs and a ‘bromance’ beyond football
Article Text:
Inside Erling Haaland’s unlikely friendship with billionaire founder: Luxury trips, WAGs and a ‘bromance’ beyond football

How Erling Haaland and Umar Kamani first became friends

How Erling Haaland and Umar Kamani have stayed close

Erling Haaland’s friendship with PrettyLittleThing founder Umar Kamani is not the usual football friendship. The Manchester City striker and the billionaire fashion businessman have been close since they met in 2022, with their bond taking them from Manchester to Dubai, Monaco and the French Riviera. Their partners and friends have also joined them on some of these trips. This summer, after Norway’s World Cup campaign, Haaland and Kamani were seen holidaying together in the south of France. The friendship has also opened doors into each other’s worlds, including a reported link-up between Haaland and basketball legend Michael Jordan.The Daily Mail reported that Haaland first started visiting the PrettyLittleThing offices in Manchester after he joined Manchester City in 2022. Kamani, a Manchester City supporter, already knew several players, and they helped introduce him to Haaland.The two quickly became friends. Football was an obvious connection, but they also share an interest in luxury watches, travel and trying different experiences. Haaland’s relaxed personality appears to have helped the relationship grow naturally. As the report put it, his attitude was simply: “why not?”Their friendship soon moved beyond Manchester. During the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, which Norway did not qualify for, Haaland took a break and visited Kamani in Dubai.By the following summer, Haaland and his father Alf-Inge Haaland were spending time with Kamani on a yacht. Fashion designer Tommy Hilfiger was also part of that trip, and the group later met Prince Albert II of Monaco for lunch. The 2023 gathering was also reported by Goal.Haaland and Kamani continued to spend time together in Dubai. The footballer attended a New Year party hosted by Kamani and also visited the businessman’s private gym, The Kamani Club. They were photographed together in ice baths after training.Their social circles have overlapped too. Kamani’s wife Nada and Haaland’s partner Isabel Haugseng Johansen have been part of their wider holiday group. The friendship has also connected Haaland to people outside football, with the Daily Mail reporting that one of Kamani’s close friends helped arrange Haaland’s recent meeting with Michael Jordan.There is also a personal side to the friendship. Haaland is known for the amount of work he puts into his fitness and recovery, while Kamani built his career around the fashion business. Both have demanding professional lives, but they appear to have found time to spend away from work.That became particularly clear after Haaland’s exhausting 2025-26 season. The Manchester City striker played 67 games for club and country and later said on Snapchat that his brain was “fried”. His summer was even busier because Norway made a historic run at the 2026 World Cup.Haaland scored twice as Norway beat Brazil 2-1 in the last 16, sending the country into the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time. He finished the tournament with seven goals after Norway lost 2-1 to England after extra time.Kamani has also built a major name for himself through PrettyLittleThing. He co-founded the fashion company with his brother Adam in 2012 after growing up in Manchester and coming from a family involved in fashion. Speaking to Drapers, he once explained his connection to the industry: “It’s impossible for me not to be working in fashion. I was born into fashion. That’s like saying if you couldn’t breathe what would you do?”His business career has not been without controversy. Boohoo, the parent company linked to the Kamani family, faced major criticism over working conditions in Leicester in 2020. The company later faced further legal claims from investors. In response to those claims, Boohoo said: “The company strongly contests the allegations and will vigorously defend any claim.”For Haaland and Kamani, however, the friendship has continued through football seasons, business demands and trips abroad. Their connection is unusual mainly because it brings together two very different worlds, one built around elite football and the other around fashion and business, while their shared interests have kept the friendship going since 2022.
Article Summary: Erling haaland and umar kamani have been close since they met in 2022. The manchester city striker and the billionaire fashion businessman have been on trips to dubai, monaco and the french riviera. The friendship has also opened doors into each other’s worlds, including a reported link-up between haaland and basketball legend michael jordan.

Article Title: Inspiring story on fatherhood: "I love my girls. They teach me things sometimes when I think that I’m trying to teach them" - How Jason Kelce’s four daughters changed his life beyond football
Article Text:
How Jason Kelce found a different kind of success through fatherhood

Why Jason and Kylie Kelce use a divide-and-conquer approach

How Kylie Kelce is teaching her daughters confidence and body positivity

What Jason and Kylie Kelce want their children to learn about life

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Jason Kelce spent his NFL career absorbing lessons from coaches, teammates and opponents. But according to the former Philadelphia Eagles center, some of his most meaningful lessons have come from his daughters. Fatherhood has changed the way he sees success, patience and family, giving the retired NFL star a perspective that extends far beyond the football field.Kelce became a father while his football career was still developing. He and Kylie Kelce welcomed their first daughter, Wyatt, in 2019, followed by Elliotte in 2021 and Bennett in 2023. Their fourth daughter, Finnley, arrived in March 2025.Raising four children has given Jason and Kylie plenty of chaotic moments. It has also created a family dynamic that the former NFL star clearly treasures.Jason has spoken openly about the difference between trying to teach his children and realizing that they are teaching him, too.“We had zero girls in the household growing up other than Mom [Donna Kelce], so it was a very testosterone-dominated household,” Jason told E! News in September 2023. “But my girls are so young right now. And I only have girls, so I don’t know what it’s like to be a boy dad really.All I know is a girl dad. And I love my girls. I love my children. They teach me things sometimes when I think that I’m trying to teach them.”That admission says plenty about how Kelce views his role as a father. His daughters are not simply growing up around an NFL legend. They are helping shape the person he is becoming after football.He even found himself reflecting on a children's book in a completely different way.“For instance, I’m reading the kids’ book Oh, The Places You’ll Go! [by] Dr. Seuss, and it’s in the documentary. And I’m like, ‘I feel like I’m getting more out of this than the kids are right now.’”The moment is easy to relate to. Parents often expect to be the ones providing wisdom. Kelce's experience suggests the relationship works both ways.Four children can turn an ordinary day into a logistical challenge. Jason and Kylie have learned that teamwork matters.Kylie once explained that they divide responsibilities depending on the children's ages and needs.“Bennie, I’ve been less on because I’ve been handling Wyatt and Elliotte,” Jason said during a September 2023 episode of his podcast. “Here’s the thing: You gotta have strategies [and] there’s techniques involved.”Kylie added that Jason usually takes responsibility for the toddlers while she handles the newborn.That arrangement reflects something many parents eventually discover. There is no perfect formula for raising children. What works one week may fail the next. Parents have to adjust, communicate and sometimes simply survive the chaos.Kylie has also joked about Jason's ability to handle baby duty.“I think my headphones cut out,” Kylie joked. “But then, who’s watching you? … I’d probably leave you for one hour. I feel like Travis can stand longer than you can, [Jason]. That’s a game-changer when it comes to watching small babies: Bennett right now, she’s happy as a clam if you get up and walk around with her. [Jason] isn’t willing to make that commitment. His back locks up and then that’s the end of it.”The humor behind the exchange shows the couple's willingness to laugh at the messy parts of parenting rather than pretend they have everything figured out.Jason's approach to fatherhood is only one part of the family's parenting philosophy. Kylie has also spoken about the example parents set through everyday language.During a 2024 appearance on Good Morning America, she explained why she pays close attention to the way she talks about her own body around her daughters.“I am now hyper aware of how I talk about myself and my body. Not only in front of my daughters, but in front of my players,” Kylie explained during a January 2024 appearance on Good Morning America. “I think it’s important to model that positive body talk about yourself because then they are taking that away from what you’re doing.”She wants her daughters to learn self-respect by seeing it modeled at home.“We’re making it a point right now to emphasize a positive tone when we talk about anything bodywise,” she said. “Like our one daughter will sort of rub her belly and I’m like, ‘Oh, that is the most beautiful belly I’ve ever seen.'”It is a lesson that goes beyond appearance. Children absorb the way adults speak about themselves. For the Kelces, creating a healthy environment means thinking carefully about those small moments.Fame and wealth could easily create a very different childhood for the Kelce daughters. Jason and Kylie, however, have repeatedly emphasized keeping their children grounded.Kylie explained that family and close friends play an important role in maintaining that sense of normalcy.“We stay surrounded by family and friends, so we keep the people around us very close to us,” Kylie told Us. “Then, we make sure that anything that we’re doing that they feel supported by their family and friends and then also not really putting them in any places of privilege.”She also joked about what she hopes their daughters' future cars will look like.“[We’re] trying our best to make sure that when they grow up and they turn 16, they will be driving a [used vehicle]. We can’t let them have a hand-me-down car at this point. You’re not getting Dad’s [Tesla] CyberTruck as your hand-me-down. You will be driving a basic model, hopefully, having to roll the windows down with a crank.”The family has also accepted that parenting cannot always be done alone. Kylie has been open about using childcare, even when Jason is at home.“My husband could tell me 72 times that he is going to be in the house during the time when I have to leave it, [and] I will still schedule childcare,” Kylie explained in December 2024, adding it’s “not a knock” on Jason. “My husband is busier than he has ever been. I see him less now in retirement than I did when he was playing football. We had a set schedule then, now it is an absolute free-for-all.”That honesty may be one of the most relatable parts of their parenting story. Behind the fame, the podcasts and the NFL legacy is a family trying to figure things out one day at a time.Jason Kelce's greatest lesson from fatherhood may therefore be surprisingly simple. Children do not just need parents who teach them how to succeed. They need parents willing to listen, learn and grow alongside them.For a man who spent years being judged by wins, losses and championships, that may be the most valuable scorecard of all.
Article Summary: Jason and kylie kelce welcomed their first daughter in 2019, followed by elliotte in 2021 and bennett in 2023. Their fourth daughter, finnley, arrived in march 2025. Jason has spoken openly about the difference between trying to teach his children and realizing that they are teaching him, too.

Article Title: Mohammed Kaif 'surprised' by BCCI's struggle to hire top medical professionals amid injury crisis
Article Text:

Mohammad Kaif questions BCCI's inability to attract top medical experts

India's growing injury crisis has raised fresh questions over the functioning of the BCCI's Centre of Excellence (CoE), with former cricketer Mohammad Kaif expressing surprise that the world's richest cricket board has struggled to recruit some of the world's leading medical and rehabilitation professionals.The latest setback came with Sai Sudharsan being ruled out of India's upcoming two-Test series against Sri Lanka due to a toe injury. He joins Jasprit Bumrah, Harshit Rana, Nitish Kumar Reddy and Washington Sundar on the list of players unavailable for the Sri Lanka series because of injuries.The repeated injury setbacks have frustrated the BCCI, particularly as several players have had to make trips to the CoE in Bengaluru for rehabilitation. The issue also came into focus when BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia travelled to Bengaluru to discuss the situation with CoE head VVS Laxman.Laxman, during a press conference, revealed that the BCCI has been facing difficulties in finding the right personnel for the CoE. According to him, the board had approached several candidates, but some potential appointments fell through at the final stage.The revelation has now drawn a strong reaction from Kaif, who questioned how the BCCI, despite its enormous financial resources, has been unable to bring some of the best medical professionals and physiotherapists into its setup."There was a statement from VVS Laxman that they had approached several people. Those things were being worked out, but at the last minute, they turned it down. So, what I am trying to say is that whatever is happening needs to be fixed. I am not an expert on this. The experts appointed by the BCCI need to do their job. But I am telling you that it is having a significant impact," Kaif said on his YouTube channel.Kaif admitted that he was particularly surprised by the situation given the financial strength of the BCCI and the attractiveness of working with Indian cricket."Now, I am surprised because so many people are eager to work with the BCCI. We have so much money that if we call someone, they will come running. They do, don't they? Just look at the players. Players leave their countries' matches to come and play in the IPL. They come, don't they?" Kaif said.He further questioned why the BCCI had not been able to finalise contracts with leading physiotherapists and medical experts."So, I was a little surprised that we haven't been able to work things out with some of the world's best physiotherapists and medical professionals and get them to work with the BCCI. I am surprised because we pay so much. We offer such good contracts. If someone comes and works here, they are bound to make a lot of money. They get paid very well," he added.The timing of the concerns is significant, with India heading into a two-Test series against Sri Lanka without several key players. The series begins in Galle on August 15.

Article Title: BWF: World’s best set for Delhi showdown as Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu face star-studded field

NEW DELHI: The return of the BWF World Championships to India after 17 years will see an international field ready to test singles stars Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu . The event, scheduled from Aug 17-23 at the Indira Gandhi indoor stadium, will bring together the sport’s biggest names, with reigning world champions, Olympic gold medallists and former world No. 1s lining up for a battle.In men’s singles, China’s world No. 1 and reigning world champion Shi Yu Qi will start among the favourites, meeting India’s Ayush Shetty in the opener. The 30-year-old, who claimed his maiden world title in 2025 after finishing runner-up in 2018, combines deceptive strokeplay with tactical nous and an ability to control rallies.Thailand’s Kunlavut Vitidsarn, the 2023 world champion and Paris Olympics silver medallist, adds a threat. A three-time world junior champion, Kunlavut has established himself as one of the toughest players on the circuit with his movement, patience and composure under pressure.For India, much will rest on Sen. The 2021 world bronze medallist made history by becoming the first Indian man to reach an Olympic singles semifinal in Paris, finishing fourth. With home support behind him, the 24-year-old will look to turn a major occasion into a medal-winning run.The women’s field is equally imposing. Sindhu, India’s first world champion and a five-time World Championships medallist, enters her home campaign on the back of a historic 2026 Japan Open triumph. The two-time Olympic medallist remains one of India’s biggest medal hopes.Standing in her way is South Korea’s An Se Young, the reigning Olympic and 2023 world champion, who completed a career Grand Slam by winning the Badminton Asia Championships this year.Japan’s Akane Yamaguchi, a three-time world champion, is a contender while China’s Wang Zhi Yi, the 2026 All England champion and former world No. 1, arrives in form. Olympic champion Chen Yufei, runner-up at last year’s Worlds, will also chase the individual title missing from her collection.

Article Title: 'I would be very worried': Former Sri Lankan cricketer names India's biggest weapon

Maharoof warns Sri Lanka about Rishabh Pant threat

Former Sri Lanka all-rounder Farveez Maharoof believes India could opt for three spinners in the opening Test against Sri Lanka, with young left-arm spinner Manav Suthar potentially getting the nod ahead of uncapped off-spinner Saransh Jain.India will be without the retired Ravichandran Ashwin and injured Washington Sundar for the first Test, leaving Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeep Yadav as the likely first-choice spinners. The bigger selection question is who joins them in the XI.Maharoof feels Suthar could have an advantage because of his ability to extract bounce from the surface. Sri Lankan pitches can offer assistance to spinners through bounce rather than simply producing substantial turn, making that quality particularly useful.Suthar made an impressive start to his international career, claiming seven wickets on his debut against Afghanistan. Jain, meanwhile, is yet to make his India debut but has also put himself in contention after touring Sri Lanka with India A.The 31-year-old off-spinner picked up seven wickets on that tour and also contributed an unbeaten 70 while batting at No. 7.However, Maharoof believes Suthar's ability to generate bounce could outweigh the benefit of having an off-spinner for variation, even if that would leave India with three left-arm spinners."If you ask me, I would be tempted to go with the two left-arm spinners as well as Kuldeep Yadav. Kuldeep is a frontrunner to start in Galle, especially considering his record and the number of wickets he took in the last Test against Afghanistan."I see three spinners for India. Jadeja, Kuldeep Yadav and either Suthar or Jain. Ideally, you would like an off-spinner for variation, but I would not be surprised if Manav Suthar plays because his ability to get bounce off the surface could be very handy in Galle."Maharoof expects India to go into the Test with a balanced attack comprising three spinners and two seamers."Overall, looking at India's bowling line-up, it is quite competitive, with two seamers and three spinners."Maharoof also singled out Rishabh Pant as a major threat for Sri Lanka, despite the wicketkeeper-batter's modest returns in India's three-day warm-up game in Colombo.Pant scored just two and 28 in the match, which India won by six wickets. However, Maharoof believes those scores should not give Sri Lanka any confidence ahead of the Test, given Pant's ability to transform a match within a short period."If I were in the Sri Lankan dressing room, I would be very worried about Rishabh Pant. He is a player who, within half an hour or 45 minutes, can completely change the game."We have seen him do it in the past. He has that X-factor and has been given the licence to play his natural game. He is going to face a lot of left-arm spin and off-spin.Maharoof expects Sri Lanka to rely heavily on spin against Pant, predicting that the hosts will field two frontline spinners along with two part-time options. But he believes Pant's unconventional approach could still make him difficult to contain."Sri Lanka will surely go with two frontline spinners as well as two part-timers, but the way Pant scores runs, with his unorthodox style, he is going to be dangerous."
Article Summary: Farveez maharoof believes india could opt for three spinners in the opening test against sri lanka. Young left-arm spinner manav suthar could potentially get the nod ahead of uncapped off-spinner saransh jain. India will be without the retired ravichandran ashwin and injured washington sundar for the first test.

Article Title: Duan Jansen, Marco’s twin brother, earns maiden South Africa call-up for Namibia tour

South Africa look to build depth

Duan Jansen, twin brother of South Africa all-rounder Marco Jansen , has earned his maiden senior call-up and could make his international debut during South Africa’s upcoming white-ball tour of Namibia.The 15-member squad, led by experienced spinner Bjorn Fortuin , will play a T20I tri-series involving Namibia and Zimbabwe before taking on Namibia in a historic three-match ODI series.The T20I tri-series will be played in Windhoek from August 28 to September 6, followed by three ODIs against Namibia from September 9 to 13. The ODI series will be the first bilateral 50-over contest between the two neighbouring countries.Duan’s selection comes after an impressive 2025/26 domestic season. He was named Division 1 One Day Cup Player of the Year and played a key role in helping the Titans win the title, scoring an unbeaten 61 in the final against the Lions.Eathan Bosch is the other uncapped T20I player, while Connor Esterhuizen, Jordan Hermann and Nqobani Mokoena have received their first ODI call-ups.“We’ve selected one squad for both series as we feel we have all departments well covered and it provides a great opportunity for players to build on their international caps.We saw glimpses of what Connor and Nqobani can offer during the T20I series against New Zealand earlier this year. It was unfortunate that Jordan picked up an injury in the opening match of that series, so we’re looking forward to seeing him get another opportunity at this level.Coach Shukri Conrad said using the same squad for both formats would give the players greater continuity and valuable international exposure. Nationally contracted players Dewald Brevis, Tony de Zorzi and Kwena Maphaka will provide additional experience.“This tour has also opened the door for players who have performed domestically. Duan is one of those players. He is a quality all-rounder who has also shown great character for the Titans. Bjorn is an experienced player and proven leader who has successfully captained the Lions, and we have every confidence in his ability to lead this group. It is always exciting to play against our neighbouring countries, and the first-ever ODI series between South Africa and Namibia adds further significance, especially as we build towards next year’s World Cup,” he added.South Africa are scheduled to leave Johannesburg for Windhoek on August 25.

Article Title: Born in Cristiano Ronaldo's hometown, former Australia cricketer to lead Portugal's T20 World Cup bid

Former Australia all-rounder Moises Henriques will captain Portugal as they attempt to qualify for the T20 World Cup for the first time.Henriques, who played four Tests, 16 ODIs and 24 T20Is for Australia, will lead Portugal's 14-member squad at the T20 World Cup Europe Sub-Regional Qualifier C in Finland.The Portuguese Cricket Federation announced the squad on Tuesday, with Henriques named captain. He was born in Madeira, the hometown of Portugal football captain Cristiano Ronaldo , before his family moved to Australia when he was a child.Henriques played 24 T20Is, 16 ODIs and four Tests for Australia. His last international appearance came in August 2021, when he played a T20I against Bangladesh. He became eligible to represent Portugal in June after completing the required three-year cooling-off period for players switching from an ICC Full Member to an Associate nation.Henriques announced last month that he was retiring from Australian domestic cricket but would continue playing overseas. He has a contract with Glasgow Cosmic for the inaugural season of the European T20 Premier League. On Monday, he was also named Portugal's captain for their T20 World Cup qualifying campaign in Finland.Portugal are ranked 37th in the ICC men's T20I rankings. They will face Israel, Germany, Greece and Czechia in Group B of the T20 World Cup Europe Sub-Regional Qualifier C from August 14 to 20.The group winner will face the winner of Group A in the final on August 21.The winner of the qualifier will advance to the European regional final, where Scotland, Jersey and Denmark will join them. The top two teams from the regional final will then qualify for the global qualifier as they bid to reach the 2028 T20 World Cup in Australia and New Zealand.Portugal's squad also features Craig Cachopa, the former Sussex, Auckland and Wellington wicketkeeper-batter; Cameron Shekleton, who has represented South Africa A; Sebastian de Oliveira, who played one List A match for Gauteng alongside Ryan Rickelton; and Bangladesh-born spinner Siraj Ullah Khadem, who was included in the longlist for this year's Hundred auction.Henriques takes over the captaincy from Carlos Nunes, who captains Twickenham in the Middlesex County Cricket League in England. Nunes remains part of the 14-member squad.Moises Henriques (capt), Craig Cachopa, Edward Fleming, Christopher de Freitas, Rahulkumar Hashu, Siraj Ullah Khadem, Hardeep Khuttan, Jeremy Martins, Dhavalkumar Norotam (wk), Jordan Netto, Carlos Nunes, Sebastian de Oliveira, Upen Shantu, Cameron Shekleton.vs Israel (August 14), vs Germany (August 15), vs Greece (August 17), vs Czechia (August 20), Final (August 21).
